name: the face's vendored document renderers
policy: Pinned, offline-capable, lazy-loaded per format. Never a CDN at render time. Each entry: version, upstream, the exact download URL, the SHA-256 of the vendored file, the SPDX license, and the reason. Re-verify provenance with shasum -a 256.

entries.name: DOMPurify
entries.reason: The sanitizer between document-derived HTML and the pane's DOM (markdown hardening, D2).

entries.name: PDF.js
entries.reason: PDF rendering inside the fence (D3): the sandbox disables the browser's native viewer, so the fence chooses PDF.js — API mode, scripting disabled, the document as data.

entries.name: PDF.js worker
entries.reason: PDF.js's parse worker — the pair with pdf.min.mjs, one version pin.

entries.name: docx-preview
entries.reason: DOCX rendering (D5) — runs inside the sandboxed frame, its output never touches the app's origin.

entries.name: JSZip
entries.reason: docx-preview's dependency, the zip reader the DOCX render needs inside the frame.
